newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices - Sept 17.

text.p: International prices for milling and Durum wheat were lower pressured by improved weather forecasts across the US Midwest and aggressive pricing of French wheat into Egypt, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said. Wheat indicator prices for multi-grade contracts 96/97 fell by A$2.00. The Durum price also fell by A$1.00.
Prices, FOB, in A$ per tonne:

NOTE: The indicator price represents the current state of the international wheat market. It is a cash contract price offered today by the AWB for wheat delivered during the 1996/97 harvest. The offer is valid until 4.30 p.m. Australian Eastern Standard Time (0630 GMT) and Eastern Standard Summer Time (0530GMT).
Indicator prices will be revised daily until October.
